data.name: Strangers in a Strange Land
data.detailed_description:
Strangers In a Strange Land – SIASL is a modern erotic and thriller adventure game with focus on the hero Billy.

18 year old , college Student Billy goes with his step-family, his brother and his fiancee, to a farm that his step-dad recently bought in an auction.

From the first moment that they arrive there, strange things start to happen … Will Billy find out what is going on? Is his family in danger? Will he survive? Only one way to find out!

Dive in into the 1990's-2000's adventure style game of point-and-click but with HD graphics! Game is easy to progress at first with a two difficult puzzles towards the end.

Play time of roughly 1-2 hours IF you are following a walk-through but depending on the first time player the game promises a lot more play time.

The game currently contains :

1. Puzzles where Billy needs to find clues on what is going on
2. Adult scenes with and without Billy
3. Animated adult scenes with click-to-progress option

reviews.review:
we both know why you're here. 
1)yes there is a censorship removal patch. check the forums
2)there are 5 sex scenes (4 are with a characters [?step?]mother)

if you like the pics in the hub sure grab this. i've seen worse sell for more so its your choice. it has been bundled so it should be able to be found for cheap(er). a warning, the sex scenes pop up unexpectedly though some can be guessed at before they happen and they sometimes lag really hard. they also leave you wishing there was more but if you take into account length of content to scenes its a good pace. 

the point in click part if very basic and you'll be spending most of your time pixel hunting items or finding triggers to move the story forward. some of the items are hard to see and you get no hints but if you know where items are you could get through this in about an hour. there are a few posts in the forums with full details on what to do if you get stuck or if you don't care about doing it yourself.

as for the story it gets the job done connecting events and why things happen. it seems there was some thought (maybe to much) into the story if you think about the 4th sex scene, the plot, and why it didn't happen. 

is it a good game? no. does sex sell? yes. if you're into these kinds of games its not bad but still on the low scale. there is the mother/son thing and is what may turn off (or excite) most players. though i see step-family in the description i dont remember seeing the mother being called a step-mother and even if so it would go against the story a bit if she was also seeing "mom" said during sex scenes even a step-mother is still a turn off for most.
